evidence.claim: Inspected the relevant Makefile and .agents skill files for the Graphify maintenance route.
Opened the canonical graphify-aria-boundary reference and the Graphify upstream-skill test, identifying the accepted bundle manifest owner and its exact verification contract.
Inspected .agents/skills/README.md and the vendored Graphify bundle metadata.
Verified the pinned local Graphify tree/blob provenance, tracked-file count, clean worktree, and clean bundle diff.

items.command: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && printf '%s\\n' '--- candidates ---' && rg --files -g '*graphify*' -g '*manifest*' -g '*provenance*' -g '*bundle*' -g 'AGENTS.md' | head -120 && printf '%s\\n' '--- references ---' && rg -n -i \"byte.?identical|provenance|manifest|upstream bytes|refresh.*Graphify|Graphify.*refresh|integrity\" . --glob '"'!graphify-out/**'"' --glob '"'!*.lock'"' | head -160"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '220,270p' Makefile; rg --files .agents | sort | head -120; rg -n -i \"graphify-skill|upstream.*skill|skill.*upstream|manifest\" .agents scripts Makefile pyproject.toml | head -200"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "find . -path '*test_graphify_upstream_skill.py' -o -path '*skill-codex.md' -o -path '*graphify*manifest*'; git status --porcelain=v1; git ls-files .agents/skills/graphify | wc -l; git ls-files .agents/skills/graphify | head -20"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "find . -type f | rg 'test_graphify|upstream_skill|graphify.*skill' | head -50; find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -name 'Makefile' -print; sed -n '65,90p' .agents/skills/README.md; cat .agents/skills/graphify/.graphify_version; git log -1 --oneline -- .agents/skills/graphify .agents/skills/aria-nbv-context/references/graphify-aria-boundary.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git rev-parse HEAD:.agents/skills/graphify; git ls-tree -r --full-tree HEAD -- .agents/skills/graphify | sed 's#"'^[''^ ]* [''^ ]* [''^ ]*'"\\t##' | wc -l; git status --porcelain=v1; git diff --quiet -- .agents/skills/graphify && echo graphify_bundle_clean; git diff --quiet -- .agents/skills/aria-nbv-context/references/graphify-aria-boundary.md && echo manifest_owner_clean; git ls-tree HEAD:.agents/skills/graphify"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "set -eu
printf 'local_tree='; git rev-parse HEAD:.agents/skills/graphify
printf 'local_skill_blob='; git rev-parse HEAD:.agents/skills/graphify/SKILL.md
printf 'reference_tree='; git rev-parse HEAD:.agents/skills/graphify/references
printf 'tracked_files='; git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD -- .agents/skills/graphify | wc -l
printf 'worktree='; if test -z \""'$(git status --porcelain=v1)"; then echo clean; else git status --short; fi
printf '"'bundle_diff='; if git diff --quiet -- .agents/skills/graphify; then echo clean; else echo changed; fi"
